* docs: a reduced-motion reader sees a drawn frame for a live example that never settles (rich-docs-examples-xuu.tig)

The still frame is the screen when the body settles or a second after the
program first draws, whichever is sooner, so a loop, a prompt, and a
fullscreen run that ends back on the main screen each show a frame.
